l2-forward: Paddle forward and hold a straight line for about 200 yards. It is about tracking straight, not going fast.
l2-reverse: Paddle backward about 50 yards and stay in control of where the boat goes. Glance over your shoulder to steer.
l2-stopping: Bring the boat to a stop in a short distance from a brisk pace, both moving forward and moving backward.
l2-sweep: Turn the boat with a wide sweep stroke while you keep moving. The turn stays smooth and does not stall your glide.
l2-wet-exit: After a capsize, get out of the upside-down kayak calmly. Show two different ways to do it.
l2-assisted-rescue: Help another paddler back into their boat after a capsize, and let them help you. Know at least one method: Side-by-Side, Sling, or T-Rescue.
